summary: Iteration 5 verified: Season Auto-Close + Streak Badges. Backend auto-close triggered by PATCH end_date to past then GET /api/seasons; new 'Season N+1' created with auto_created_from set correctly; old season active=false with closed_at populated. Idempotency confirmed (3 repeat GET calls kept count stable). Streak field present in /api/stats/leaderboard rows and top-level in /api/stats/player/{id}. Frontend Leaderboard on Season 1 renders StreakBadge for Nova (-3 loss), Kaito (+4 win), Onyx (-6 loss); rows with |streak|<3 (Zara, Ember, Ryker, Vex, Storm) show none. PlayerProfile header (Nova) renders StreakBadge (loss).
passed: Auto-close: PATCH end_date past on active Season 3 -> GET /api/seasons closed it (closed_at set, active=false) and created 'Season 4' with auto_created_from=Season 3 id
Auto-close idempotency: 3 consecutive GET /api/seasons calls kept count at 6 (no duplicate new seasons)
GET /api/stats/leaderboard?season_id=<Season 1> returns integer 'streak' field on all 10 rows (values: -1,2,-3,2,4,0,0,1,1,-6)
Login flow works with admin@arenaops.gg / admin123
Leaderboard UI: exact match of expected badges on Season 1 (1 win-badge Kaito 4, 2 loss-badges Nova 3 & Onyx 6); rows with |streak|<3 correctly show no badge
PlayerProfile header (Nova) renders StreakBadge (loss variant) as expected
notes: Regression flows (log/edit/delete match, matchmaking, recap, CSV, PvP matrix, champion matrix, MMR chart, notes) were not re-executed in this smoke run; they were validated in iterations 1-4. Recommend full-testing agent revisit them post first-finish.
